component.name: HashChat
component.summary: Maximum anonymity messenger — Tor-only, Double Ratchet, strong OPSEC

description.p: HashChat is a privacy-first, metadata-resistant messenger designed for people who need serious protection against advanced adversaries.

It uses real Double Ratchet cryptography with forward secrecy, Tor v3 hidden services by default, burner profiles with aggressive isolation, and an extremely fast panic wipe that destroys all cryptographic material.
The project follows a maximum paranoid philosophy: minimal attack surface, reproducible builds, and honest documentation of limitations.

ul.li: Real Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope for Android ratchet export
Live Security Posture system with visual indicators on both platforms
9+ Rust tests and expanded instrumented test coverage

screenshot.caption: Main chat interface with live Security Posture indicator
